Title: SSH collector
Description: As a desktop user, I want to fetch code from remote servers via SSH so that I can analyze on-premise repositories. The app uses SSH.NET for SFTP, requires a pinned host-key fingerprint, accepts a private key file and optional passphrase, and never loads ssh-agent or ssh config. Files are cached locally.
AcceptanceCriteria: SSH collector uses SSH.NET for SFTP only (not SSH shell)
Host-key fingerprint is pinned and verified before connection
Private key is loaded from a user-selected file
Private key passphrase is stored in Credential Manager
SSH agent and system ssh config are never accessed
SFTP file tree is fetched recursively
Files are downloaded and cached in SQLite with metadata
Collector UI allows user to enter host, port, username, key file, and fingerprint
All code for this story lives inside Cortexa-dev/desktop/collector; nothing in services/, contracts/, frontend/ or deploy/ is edited or referenced (outside logic is re-implemented inside)
TalkingPoints: Building an SSH collector using SSH.NET with host-key pinning for security. Private keys are loaded from files; passphrases stored in Credential Manager. System ssh-agent and config are never accessed.

Tasks.Description: Use SSH.NET for SFTP; fetch file tree and contents recursively.

Tasks.Title: Implement host-key fingerprint pinning

Tasks.Title: Load private key from file with optional passphrase

Tasks.Title: Cache SFTP files in SQLite

Tasks.Title: Build SSH collector UI
Tasks.Description: Settings panel for host, port, username, key file picker, fingerprint input.

Tasks.Title: Test SSH connection and file fetching
Tasks.Description: Verify connection, fingerprint verification, and file cache.

Tests.Title: SSH connection succeeds with correct fingerprint

Steps.Expected: SSH.NET connects via SFTP; file tree is fetched
Connection fails with fingerprint mismatch error

Tests.Title: Private key passphrase is handled correctly

Steps.Action: Load encrypted private key; enter passphrase
Steps.Expected: Key is unlocked; SSH connection succeeds
Files appear in SQLite cache with host/path metadata
